title: Add community guidance and review support for Business Central agents
summary: Business Central agent developers gain 20 community-authored guidance rules covering agent registration, permissions, profiles, instructions, session handling, and lifecycle management, with good and bad code examples for each rule.
key_points: 20 new community guidance rules for agent SDK implementations
Each rule includes documentation and contrasting AL code examples
Coverage spans registration, permissions, profiles, setup persistence, instructions, session behavior, and API design
New standalone al-agents-review action skill for automated review
Rules address least-privilege access, secure storage, lifecycle management, and input validation
quote: Adds a new community knowledge domain for reviewing Business Central Agent SDK implementations.
